commits.subject: Enable network access in the shell snapshot filesystem test (#62415)
commits.reason: Adopt the upstream workspace-denial test fixture so its filesystem check reaches the shell on remote runners.
evidence: Only the second-workspace-root denial fixture selects the platform sandbox here. It keeps the denied filesystem rule and enables test network access to avoid requiring a nested network namespace before shell startup.

The other five fixture modes retain their existing profile. The dedicated network-denial case still uses its cancellation token. The production shell snapshot, permission profiles, credential handling and ALab-owned rules are outside this patch.
commits.revisit: Use a supported platform runner to observe the second-workspace-root denial and descendant cleanup.
